data.turoyo: W məd məṣṣe, disa frišənne, maḥtənne bi+kozḳe bašqa. Omar ‘bəždəm’, disa rawiʕi kulle bi+kozḳe.
data.translation: After they sucked, they separated them again, they put them in another pen. He says, ‘Lat me bind ye’, they all lay down in the pen again.

rationale: First active Preterit box: plural agent separates kids, with plural incorporated patient; not Detransitive.

data.turoyo: Komər azzele l kone, komər l kone barayto, frəšto mu wel, komər čik taḥta.
data.translation: Er ging zu einem Zelte, das außerhalb, abgetrennt von dem Stamme, aufgestellt war, und schlüpfte darunter. (Es war das Zelt einer alten Frau.)

rationale: First Detransitive Part. Pass. box: feminine result-state modifier of an isolated tent; keep derivational classification provisional.

data.translation: With crops, we understand, like, there appeared new technologies,

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 3.56/1650)

data.turoyo: W d əzzən bəṯre ḥasyo Naṣṭur, d frəšle ruḥe mina šan xaṭər di manfaʕa d ruḥe.
data.translation: And that they follow Bishop Nestorius, who separated himself from it for his own personal advantage,

rationale: Thin active Preterit cell, reflexive ruḥe plus source mina; round 1 already established the box.

data.turoyo: ʕAṭiya: Bas ṭabʕan, u fəlḥono folitiqoyo d bayn du ʕamayḏan, lə klozəm i aṯto w u gawro, d məṭroyi friše, m iḏe, ono bu ray diḏi hawxa fəlḥono lə knoǧəḥ.
data.translation: Atiya: But of course, in political activity among our people, the woman and man must not walk separately, I think; in my opinion such work does not succeed.

rationale: Thin round-1 Detransitive Part. Pass. cell; plural depictive friše with woman and man.

summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (Jan 4.II/954)

data.turoyo: ʕAṭiya: Ninorta. ʕAyni šəwolo, qayyo hawxa kəbʕina dahwo, raḏayoṯo, kəbʕina bote friše? U sabab mən yo?
data.translation: Atiya: Ninorta. The same question: why do we want gold, cars, why do we want separate houses? What is the reason?

rationale: Fourth cumulative Detransitive Part. Pass. context; separate houses is an attributive modifier of the object, not a finite subject.

data.turoyo: Laybux dəḏʕat, lo i+kefo áynayo, w lo ayna loyo. Ktowe msawyo ʕam+ḥḏoḏe, lo+kfərqatle. Laybux furšatle me ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: You cannot recognize either which is the stone or which is not. It becomes equal to one another, you cannot separate it. You cannot distinguish one from another.

rationale: First cognitive-discrimination example; preserve both the recognition context and the physical-separation alternative.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (65/519)

data.turoyo: La tre mḥalle b ḥḏoḏe maʕazər allah! Xəd qoləb tre ṭurone ʕal ḥḏoḏe, raqaraq das sayfaṯṯƏ kokole bi šmayo w i ʕaskar d Mir Mḥamma hawxa kalyo w komaṣiṯo aʕlayye w nošo laybe forašše m ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Die beiden schlugen auf einander ein, daß Gott erbarm! so wie zwei Berge übereinander stürzen, so stieg das krachen ihrer Schwerter zum Himmel empor. Und die Soldaten von Mir Mḥamma blieben stehen und hörten ihnen zu, und kein Mensch konnte sie trennen.

rationale: Second active Infectum sense-1 example: animate patients, reciprocal m- complement, and assimilated object ending.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (65/524)

data.turoyo: Bas d əzzax hat bi tane, balki fəršatte m ḥḏoḏe, hawxa noše laybe forašše.
data.translation: Geh du malallein, vielleicht bringst du sie auseinander. so kann kein Mensch sie trennen.

rationale: Third active Infectum sense-1 example contrasts feminine fəršatte with masculine forašše.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (94/103)

data.turoyo: Ḥa kozobəṭ u qḏolo w koforəš i kəzməke mu zad w ḥa koṣorəḏ w ḥa komaḥət ʕal iḏe du ṣaroḏo w ḥa ste komole as salləkat w aq qaḥfəryoṯe, koballe b iḏe du maḥtono, hul d matimi u ṣroḏaṯṯe.
data.translation: Einer nimmt auf der Erde sitzend, mit den Händen den "Hals" das herabfallende dünne Korn. Weg und trennt die Halmknoten von dem Korn. Einer siebt, einer schüttet das Getreide dem Sieber auf das sieb, und einer füllt es in Körbe oder (aus zerstampftem piḏro-Kraut über einer jene korbartige Form hergestellte) qaḥfiryōṯe, und reicht es dem Aufselütter, bis sie mit ihrem sieben fertig sind.

rationale: Fourth active Infectum sense-1 example gives overt cereal fractions and m- separation source; retain the edition's irregular German.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (93/67)

data.turoyo: W qayəm annaqla, b kadar frəšno m i=qalʕayo w aṯino.
data.translation: Und so trennte ich mich denn betrübt von jener Burg und ging nach Hause zurück.

rationale: Second Detransitive Preterit example: first-person frəšno and an inanimate m-source.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (88/119)

data.turoyo: Ḥəlla: friš ṭarošo manək, m at=ṭarošanək kulle w aṯi ʕal ʕayno.
data.translation: Sie schaut: da trennt sich einer von all jenen Reitern ab und kommt zu der Quelle unter dem Baume.

rationale: Third Detransitive Preterit example has a rider voluntarily leaving the group.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (91/53)

data.turoyo: Faqat i naqqa d mhalaxlan m i qriṯo d oṯina lu ṣaydo, lu nečir, yaʕni li hela, arbʕo, tloṯo ḥawrone ḥrene, hanək friši b darbo ḥreno, azzən bi nfoqe d yawmo da.
data.translation: Aber damals, als wir aus dem Dorfe herausmarschierten zur Jagd, d. h. auf die Vogeljagd, waren drei vier andere Kameraden, die sich von uns getrennt hatten, auf einem anderen Wege nach Sonnenaufgang gegangen.

rationale: Fourth Detransitive Preterit example gives plural companions with an alternative path.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (52/200)

data.turoyo: Ono ste, me d ḥzeli, ga i naqqa d friš mini w aṯi w məlle: "Ḥzeli xəzna" — mətyaqalli, d u darmonawo, d huleli, šrolo hawxa yo.
data.translation: Ich, da ich ja gesehen hatte, wie er sich damals von mir trennte und dann kam und sprach: Ich habe einen Schatz gesehen, glaubte, daß das Heilmittel, welches er mir gab, wirklich diese Wirkung hätte.

rationale: Fifth Detransitive Preterit example explicitly marks the person left behind with mini.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (91/25)

data.turoyo: Mkalafli aḥ ḥawronayḏi, məlli: “Hatu hwawu qaršə dəṯṯe w mḥarebu aʕmayye w ono bi ḥila gməfrašno mənxu
data.translation: Ich schlug meinen Kameraden vor: Bleibt ihr ihnen gegenüberstehen und kämpft mit ihnen, ich werde mich heimlich von euch trennen,

rationale: Second Detransitive Infectum example: first-person prospective self-directed separation with mənxu.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (Jan 4.I/109)

data.turoyo: Kforašla, mawxa ste kfəršo, yaʕni mbadaltoyo i mġalto ma mġale ḥrene.
data.translation: One distinguishes it; likewise it is distinct, that is, the magazine is different from the other magazines.

rationale: Thin round-1 cognitive-discrimination cell; magazine context makes physical detachment implausible.

summary: example for sense 3 in Infectum (Jan 4.I/109)

data.turoyo: Kforašla, mawxa ste kfəršo, yaʕni mbadaltoyo i mġalto ma mġale ḥrene.
data.translation: One distinguishes it; likewise it is distinct, that is, the magazine is different from the other magazines.

rationale: New intransitive comparator construction, contrasted with transitive Kforašla in the same context.

summary: Active frišənne with an incorporated plural patient is distinct from agentless friš/friši; homographic result stems must be classified from arguments.
Detransitive uses include self-directed departure and static separation; neither requires an external separating agent. The new Part. Pass. filing is provisional for qṭil adjectives.
In 65/524 feminine fəršatte and masculine forašše show different assimilated patient suffix shapes; preserve spellings.
57/50 lu friš darbano may be an independent noun for a fork. The following a tloṯo darbone friši has roads as its overt subject despite the German's human subject. No new road-fork idiom is asserted.
No new active Preterit box: round 1 already added it. frəšle ruḥe is an active reflexive, not a Detransitive solely because the agent and patient coincide.

The contrast Kforašla versus kfəršo separates transitive tell-apart from intransitive differ. The latter is assigned I.3 because the overt form lacks the inherited Detransitive mə- series; no silent replacement by mifrošo.

friši ne (4.II/763) is an adjectival/result-state predicate with a separate copula, not a secure finite Detransitive Preterit. friše after məṭroyi is depictive/adverbial separately; bote friše is an attributive object NP. They continue the provisional round-1 Part. Pass. filing; not new boxes.
Detransitive Preterit already has five cumulative examples; the prolonged bed-separation scene is retained as an extension and a question, not another routine cell-filler.
Can furšatle in the mortar passage mean physically detach the materials, or is cognitive discrimination conventional?
Are friše 'different technologies' and frəšto 'isolated tent' best treated in Part. Pass., or as lexical adjectives? What is frišo's exact referent in MAC Ishaq Material culture/9?
Is lu friš darbano a nominalized verbal form or an independent fork/junction noun? Collate the subject mismatch at 57/50.
Confirm intransitive kfəršo as a productive I form beside Detransitive mifroši; could this represent dialectal reduction?
Does hani d friši at 2.17/3617 mean separate works, separately issued works, or another lexical item? Do not silently substitute frs publish.
Is friš mi nvinayḏe conventional for marital abstinence or simply a contextual bed-separation expression? No divorce or permanent celibacy claim is made.
Should friši/friše with copula, as NP modifiers and as depictives be indexed in Detransitive Part. Pass. or a separate adjective entry? Preserve the distinct syntactic functions.
Separation covers cereal fractions, fighting men, animal young, riders, companions, roads and an isolated tent; abstract friše modifies technologies.
Kforašla distinguishes a magazine from other magazines; supports round-1 cognitive discrimination without repeating that proposal.
Separation extends to ecclesiastical/community division and a long-standing marital-bed separation. No event of divorce or independent abstention sense follows.
